title: Euclid's algorithm
prompt: Implement `int gcd(int a, int b)`: the greatest common divisor. While `b != 0`, replace `(a, b)` with `(b, a % b)`; the answer is the final `a`. This is the classic loop-with-variables trace.

tests.name: gcd values
tests.hint: gcd(a, 0) is a — the loop exits immediately when b starts as 0.
